title: Manager, GL Accounting
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: IN Bengaluru About the role The Manager, GL Accounting - India, is a vital leadership role responsible for the day-to-day execution, supervision, and efficiency of the GL Accounting Team based in India. This is a critical operational role where you will directly influence the quality, speed, and accuracy of our core accounting processes. You will serve as the primary on-the-ground manager, ensuring the India-based team maintains high performance (SLAs) , resolves issues efficiently, and provides necessary support to our core operational close processes. Working closely with the US-based Director, Managers and Supervisors, you will translate global process standards into effective local practice, supervise weekly and month-end closing tasks, and ensure the team is prepared to support ongoing global projects and process improvement initiatives. What you'll do: Execution, Support, and Quality Control Workforce Management & Team Leadership: Provide direct supervision and mentorship to the India-based GL operations teams, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the contracted workforce model. Month-End Close Execution: Scale the team to achieve full, autonomous ownership of month-end close accounting processes (e.g. cash, accruals, foreign payroll). Post-Close Execution & Analysis:  Own post-close execution, including timely balance sheet reconciliations and variance (flux) analysis. Process Improvement & Project Support: Partner with the US-based team to support ongoing finance transformation projects (including the ERP implementation) and process improvement initiatives. Compliance & Control Execution: Ensure the local team adheres strictly to the defined internal controls, maintaining effective documentation and evidence to support robust SOX compliance and external audit requirements. title: Crypto Compliance Senior Lead
description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.  The Robinhood Crypto Compliance team partners across the organization to develop, launch, and scale innovative crypto products and services safely and compliantly. As Robinhood’s primary point of contact for crypto compliance, the team provides real-time regulatory guidance, designs robust controls and testing, leads training and supervisory initiatives, and manages escalations across dynamic market environments. As the Crypto Compliance Senior Lead, you will serve as the Deputy AML Compliance Officer for Robinhood Crypto (RHC) and Bitstamp USA, while extending strategic compliance support to Bitstamp Global. Reporting directly to the Director of Crypto Compliance, you will play a central role in designing, evaluating, and evolving our AML/BSA and financial crimes compliance frameworks. You will work cross-functionally with product, legal, operations, and engineering leaders to uphold the highest compliance standards as our crypto ecosystem expands. This role is based in our Denver, Menlo Park, New York, Westlake office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.  What you’ll do Governance & Oversight: Serve as Deputy AML Compliance Officer for Robinhood Crypto (RHC) and Bitstamp USA, with advisory and operational support for Bitstamp Global. Program Design & Monitoring: Design, implement, test, and monitor critical AML/BSA, OFAC/sanctions, and anti-financial crime controls to ensure compliance with federal, state, and international regulatory expectations. Cross-Functional Advisory: Provide proactive regulatory advice and guidance to product, operations, legal, and business development teams on emerging crypto offerings and industry best practices. Policy Architecture: Draft, update, and maintain comprehensive compliance policies, procedures, and internal playbooks reflecting evolving laws and business lines. Inquiries & Examinations: Partner with the Director of Crypto Compliance on complex investigations and responses related to law enforcement requests, regulatory inquiries, examinations, and banking partner audits. Issue Management & Remediation: Track, validate, and document the timely remediation of control gaps and audit/testing findings within the firm’s issue management systems. Training & Enablement: Develop specialized crypto compliance training curricula and drive enterprise-wide compliance education programs. Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Monitor global crypto regulatory developments and proactively translate evolving guidance into actionable policy, system, and control enhancements. Special Projects: Lead and contribute to strategic compliance initiatives, product launches, and integration efforts across affiliated entities. What you bring Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, JD a plus but not required 7+ years in a financial crimes (AML/BSA) compliance role at a regulated financial services company, including crypto or blockchain experience Solid understanding of cryptocurrency markets and blockchain technology Familiarity with anti-money laundering regulations: Bank Secrecy Act, NYCRR Part 504, FATF standards Experience leading projects across technical and non-technical teams in a fast-changing environment Exceptional attention to detail, data analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively summarize findings in a succinct and organized manner Execution oriented mindset with the humility, drive, trustworthiness, and resourcefulness to get things done Sound understanding of compliance and operational risks and internal control frameworks CAMS certification, and experience with blockchain analytics software (E.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs) What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health ins

title: Senior Oracle Functional Lead - Record to Report
description: Role Description As the Oracle Functional Lead for Record to Report, you will own the design, configuration and evolution of the systems behind how Dropbox records, reconciles, consolidates and reports its financial results. You'll work hands-on across Oracle Fusion General Ledger, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Subledger Accounting, the custom Oracle PaaS applications that automate our close, and the integrations that bring in data from treasury, banking, payroll, expense, lease and revenue systems. This is a senior, hands-on role. You'll be the functional DRI for Record to Report: leading design on complex initiatives, configuring Oracle, and partnering with Controllership, Treasury, Tax and FP&A to make the close faster, more automated and better controlled. Responsibilities Propose and shape the multi-quarter RTR strategy and roadmap in partnership with leadership — where to invest, what to transform, what to retire — and translate it into delivery, using automation and AI to reduce manual work in the close while strengthening SOX controls Own Oracle Fusion RTR configuration hands-on across General Ledger, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Subledger Accounting, including period close, journal approvals and bank reconciliation rules Own the wider close platform estate — Oracle ARCS for account reconciliation, EDM for master data and hierarchies, and the reporting and planning integrations supporting EPM and statutory reporting   Direct offshore delivery partners on R2R build and support work Design custom integrations into Oracle from treasury, banking, HR and payroll, expense, lease and revenue systems using Oracle Integration Cloud, Workato, REST APIs and file-based FBDI and UCM patterns Design and support custom Oracle PaaS solutions that underpin close: automate journals, accruals, reconciliations, foreign currency translation, and intercompany processes . Partner with Controllership, Treasury, Tax, FP&A and vendors to translate accounting requirements into scalable solutions, and explain trade-offs in business terms Requirements Deep h ands-on Oracle Fusion Financials configuration across Record to Report including General Ledger, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Subledger Accounting and period close . Experience supporting international and statutory reporting requirements across multiple entities Experience designing and supporting integrations into a core ERP from upstream systems — using an integration platform such as Oracle Integration Cloud, Workato, REST and SOAP APIs, and file-based patterns. Comfortable supporting custom-built applications that extend the ERP, including reading and troubleshooting SQL Strong knowledge of journals, accruals, intercompany, reconciliations, FX revaluation and consolidation Led full-lifecycle Oracle implementations or major enhancements, and supported a live close cycle at a public company in a SOX-controlled environment Drive requirements conversations with stakeholders such as Accounting and FP&A in their language — what the close needs, what the accounting outcome has to be, what the deadline is. Design the technical solution behind it and explain the trade-offs back in business terms . Bring a point of view on where a process or platform should go rather than only delivering what was asked. Build a case for investment and influence a roadmap. Preferred Qualifications Working knowledge of accounting concepts relevant to close — accruals, intercompany, fixed assets, foreign currency translation — whether gained through a qualification or on the job Oracle EPM Cloud experience: ARCS, EDM, Narrative Reporting Oracle Fusion reporting: FRS, SmartView, OTBI or BI Publisher Treasury and bank integration experience, e.g., Kyriba, bank statement processing, auto-reconciliation Oracle PaaS design experience — VBCS, APEX or PL/SQL Experience with Workiva or Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations . Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this  blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
